tldr:
A large expected number of full exposures can coexist with much weaker precision for a global adoption mean. In the prescribed Erd\H{o}s--R\'enyi high-saturation experiment with IID response vectors and zero own-control adoption, Theorems~\texttt{thm:sharp-risk} and \texttt{thm:sharp-length} prove the matched original-record orders
\[
R_n(c,\kappa)\asymp c^{-1/2}\exp[-(\kappa-1/2)^2c/2],\qquad
L_n(c,\kappa)\asymp c^{-1/2}\exp[-(\kappa-1/2)c/2+z\sqrt c/2],
\]
uniformly over \(\kappa\in[3/4,5/4]\), \(\log n\ge c^4\), and \(c\ge c_0\). A clipped exposed sample mean and the exactly calibrated ancillary-allocation interval attain the respective orders. Theorem~\texttt{thm:finite-honesty} gives unconditional coverage at least \(90\%\) at every legal finite tuple. The uniform scalar package and the terminating conservative numerical-attainment algorithm are proved in Theorems~\texttt{thm:uniform-scalar-certified} and \texttt{thm:certified-honest-attainment}. Proposition~\texttt{prop:nominal-information-gap} is an unconditional corollary quantifying the gap between reciprocal realized information and reciprocal mean exposure. The contribution is this complete paired precision calculation in the stated superpopulation model. The comparison theorems preserve the different classes, targets, observation mechanisms and design optimizations of the published benchmarks; they do not transfer the paired headline to those criteria.
gap: Cortez-Rodriguez--Eichhorn--Yu restrict interaction order; Kandiros--Harshaw--S\"avje optimize designs for adversarial fixed tables; Sudijono--Dobriban--Tchetgen analyze the SUTVA design criterion. Their distinct model and minimax operations do not determine either sharp mixed-information criterion here. Generic count-risk and confidence-measure methods leave the exponentially small factor-sensitive averages unevaluated.
fill: The paired headline theorems require matched constants retaining polynomial, exponential and square-root factors, a common uniform domain, original-record converses and a total finite-honest interval. Three theorem-level separations justify the comparator boundary. The reciprocal-information corollary is conditional on the scalar sandwich and records the mechanism without substituting a generic-class theorem. The certified-attainment question turns exact calibration into an auditable reporting algorithm.
